thread:
ravi: deploy-bot blocked rc9 GA - SBOM present, vuln-scan clean, but cosign verification failed (missing bundle). tagging sec + ops for triage.
deploy-bot: automated alert: release-candidate rc9 blocked -> cosign verification failed for image redwood/inference:rc9 (bundle: none). see /artifacts/rc9. Policy: GA requires author or delegated signer.
megan: any criticals from vuln-scan?
sec-bot: vuln-scan: no criticals. policy note: packaging used transient CI signer due to key rotation; compliance requires either author signature or recorded delegation in approvals.
ravi: I can re-run cosign signing with my key but that will add ~40m. we have downstream customers expecting the release today. can we do a short soft-launch (non-enterprise regions) while I finish signing? propose: 3h timeboxed soft-launch, 5% traffic, rollback on error>0.75% or latency >1.8x.
ops-bot: deploy-bot supports scoped publish with timebox and rollback: ```/publish --image redwood/inference:rc9 --scope non-enterprise --timebox 3h --traffic 5% --rollback_on="error>0.75%|p95>1.8x"```
megan: security asks we: (1) create an approvals exception with delegation note, (2) attach signing evidence within 3h, (3) enable stricter canary probes. I'll file approval AP-1759998888 now and add monitoring hooks.
cs-team: FYI we will pause on-prem and enterprise customer rollouts until signature evidence. we'll notify customers and offer patch window.
ravi: starting manual signing job now. will post cosign logs and KMS audit when done.
deploy-bot: soft-launch scheduled in 10m: rc9-softlaunch-nonenterprise. will enforce rollback thresholds and auto-unpublish at end of timebox.
signing-bot: cosign job queued under ravi's key. ETA ~35m. logs will be posted to https://artifacts.redwood/signatures/rc9/ravi-cosign-log.txt.
megan: good. monitoring endpoints: https://obs.redwood/canaries/rc9-nonenterprise. security will watch exploitability and error metrics.
(signing complete) ravi: cosign re-run completed and uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood/signatures/rc9/ravi-cosign-log.txt. KMS audit: https://audit.redwood/kms/rotate/2025-06-02. updated approval AP-1759998888 with evidence.
sec-bot: verification passed against policy and approval updated.
deploy-bot: verification OK. GA publish allowed for all scopes.
megan: thanks — we'll proceed with full publish and unpause enterprise once artifacts are signed. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
